name: Citadel Complex: Outer Wall
summary: The fortified outer perimeter of the Muramite citadel, guarded by elite soldiers and siege emplacements.
description: The Outer Wall is the first defensive ring of the Muramite citadel. Massive Discord‑reinforced battlements rise above the Causeway, guarded by elite Muramite soldiers, siege engineers, and warcasters. The walls hum with arcane energy, powered by conduits embedded deep within the stone. Dranik resistance forces rarely reach this zone, but those who do face relentless patrols, ballista fire, and arcane suppression fields.
